description: Department of Trade and Investment Policy - Order levy on imported goods specified in Column I of the schedule hereto a surcharge at the rate specified in the corresponding entry in Column II on the Custome Import Duty both General and Preferential basis with effect from June 01, 2023 until December 31, 2023
reasoning: This gazette notification contains a legal/regulatory order issued under Section 10A of the Customs Ordinance, imposing surcharges on imported goods. It involves the amendment of customs duties and the rescinding of a previous gazette notification, which falls under legal framework and regulatory matters rather than government personnel or organizational changes.
